content: 1. At every follow-up visit, healthcare providers should inquire about the patient’s smoking history, actively discourage smoking, and promote smoking cessation for those who currently smoke. 2. The use of electronic cigarettes should be strongly discouraged in pediatric patients. 3. 4. Healthcare providers should provide ongoing support and resources to adolescents, young adults, and their families throughout the transition process to adult healthcare. 5. Pediatric and adult diabetes care teams should work collaboratively with patients and their caregivers to facilitate a seamless and effective transition to adult diabetes care.
